rules.name: Hidden Server Script
rules.description: Manifest references a server script with a suspicious or hidden name.
rules.recommendation: Inspect the referenced file. Hidden scripts with obfuscated names are red flags.

rules.name: Remote URL in Manifest
rules.description: Manifest includes a remote URL. Usually metadata, but can be a remote script loader if placed inside script directives.
rules.recommendation: Remove remote URLs from manifests if they are script loaders.

rules.name: Suspicious Dependency
rules.description: Resource depends on a resource with a suspicious or generic name.
rules.recommendation: Verify all declared dependencies exist and are trusted resources.

rules.name: Missing or Empty Manifest
rules.description: Resource directory lacks a proper manifest file, which is non-standard.
rules.recommendation: Ensure every resource has a valid fxmanifest.lua or __resource.lua.

rules.name: Script Reference to Non-Existent File
rules.description: Manifest references a script file that does not exist in the resource directory.

rules.name: Unusual File Type Included
rules.description: Manifest includes file types not normally used in FiveM resources (e.g., .exe, .dll, .bat).
rules.recommendation: Remove unusual file inclusions. Only include legitimate resource assets.
